page_title: WER 2-0 UNI | Werder Bremen v Union Berlin 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Tobias Stieler is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+7' Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a decent low shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
90+7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Werder Bremen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+6' Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) sees a yellow card from Tobias Stieler after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+6' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+5' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow pulls off a brilliant save. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' A pass by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+3' A cross into the box from Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is cleared.
90+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' A player from Werder Bremen commits a rough challenge. Tobias Stieler blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Union Berlin will take a free kick near the side line.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Some great controlled play and passing from Werder Bremen. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch so that Olivier Deman can be given a rest.
89' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Justin Njinmah.
86' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
85' Tobias Stieler shows a yellow card to Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) for a tough tackle.
84' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
84' The game has come to an end for Marvin Ducksch. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen).
82' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
81' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
80' A yellow card for a tackle by Diogo Leite (Union Berlin). Tobias Stieler doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
78' Substitution. Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) has come on for Sheraldo Becker.
78' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Robin Gosens.
78' Urs Fischer decides to make a substitution. Kevin Behrens will be replaced by Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin).
76' Leonardo Bittencourt comes off the pitch to be replaced by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen).
75' 2 - 0 What a goal that is! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Frederik Ronnow and into the net. 2:0.
73' Today's referee Tobias Stieler rightly decides to book Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) for his harsh tackle.
71' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a nice cross, but places his close-range header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
71' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
69' The current number of offsides is 3:5.
65' Urs Fischer has decided to substitute Janik Haberer and he is replaced by Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
65' One of the players from Werder Bremen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
62' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
61' The game is interrupted now, Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Tobias Stieler sends him off the pitch.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch for Brenden Aaronson.
58' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
57' Union Berlin are ruled offside.
56' The foul by Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tobias Stieler.
55' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
54' Tobias Stieler interrupts the game. One of the players from Werder Bremen won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
53' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

52' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
51' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
50' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
50' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Union Berlin are going to take it.
49' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
46' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' The resulting set piece from Werder Bremen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+2' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee signals a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
45+2' The Union Berlin players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
43' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 4:7.
41' A player from Werder Bremen commits a rough challenge. Tobias Stieler blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
38' 1 - 0 OWN GOAL! The free kick is whipped in and Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) is unlucky enough to head the ball into his own net. 1:0.
38' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle. Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) commits a foul after dangerous play. Werder Bremen are awarded the free kick.
38' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

37' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

37' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
37' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
37' The ball is cleared after Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for an infringement. Werder Bremen win a free kick.
33' Werder Bremen are seeing far more of the ball now.
31' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Michael Zetterer.
30' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. It's a free kick to Union Berlin in a dangerous position.

28' Union Berlin hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Stieler saw the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Werder Bremen.

25' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. It's a throw-in for Werder Bremen.
24' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
24' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Union Berlin was in an offside position.
22' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

17' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
17' 56:44 – the latest ball possession ratio.
15' Werder Bremen are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
11' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
11' Union Berlin are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
10' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
10' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

9' Wasted effort! Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
7' Werder Bremen keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
4' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
3' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michael Zetterer, who smothers the ball.

2' He should have scored! Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Michael Zetterer makes an easy save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Union Berlin will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Tobias Stieler.
